tone: Reverent, grounded and epic in scale, with human vulnerability and the natural world treated seriously.

depictionRules.text: Let the reference text govern what is present; use symbolic light for divine action when the text describes no visible body.
Represent communities with dignity, avoiding ethnic caricature.
Where the work's depiction rules call for a halo, use a plain unlettered gold disc.

eras.label: Creation and the patriarchs
eras.people: For human episodes, ancient Near Eastern communities; creation scenes follow the text's actual inhabitants.
eras.dress: Simple woven garments, wraps and leather sandals when clothing is present.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Natural landscapes, tents, rough stone, wells and handmade vessels appropriate to the passage.
eras.technology: Hand tools, pastoral life and early agriculture; no modern industrial materials or machinery.

eras.label: Egypt and the wilderness
eras.people: Ancient Egyptian and Levantine communities, varied in age and occupation.
eras.dress: Linen and wool garments, practical wraps and sandals.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Mudbrick and stone settlements, desert encampments, portable furnishings and handmade pottery.
eras.technology: Bronze tools, carts and animal transport; no plastic, electric lighting or modern machinery.

eras.label: Judges and kings
eras.people: Iron Age Levantine communities with regional differences.
eras.dress: Layered woven tunics, cloaks, belts and sandals.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Hill settlements, stone fortifications, courtyards, timber furnishings and earthenware.
eras.technology: Iron and bronze tools, farming implements and animal transport; nothing industrial or electric.

eras.label: Exile and return
eras.people: Levantine and Mesopotamian populations under changing ancient empires.
eras.dress: Woven robes, regional head coverings and practical travelling garments.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Brick cities, gates, administrative courtyards and rebuilt stone settlements.
eras.technology: Hand manufacture, irrigation and animal transport; no modern engines or synthetic materials.

eras.label: Roman Judea and the early church
eras.people: Eastern Mediterranean communities under Roman rule.
eras.dress: Linen and wool tunics, mantles and sandals; occupational distinctions follow the text.
eras.buildingsAndObjects: Stone villages, plastered interiors, fishing boats, markets and Roman roads.
eras.technology: Oil lamps, hand tools, sailing and animal transport; no firearms, electricity or motor vehicles.
